title: Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring
content:
SOP: Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring (SOP-RES-001)
DEPARTMENT: Psychiatry
VERSION: 2.1
ROLES: doctor, nurse
PURPOSE: Doctor order re-authorization every 12 hours and 2-hour limb checks.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring in full compliance with Psychiatry hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring in full compliance with Psychiatry hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring in full compliance with Psychiatry hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring in full compliance with Psychiatry hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring in full compliance with Psychiatry hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Psychiatry.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-RES-001 Physical and Chemical Restraint Monitoring v2.1, Section 4
